Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot

analysis.summary: Galaxy Surfactants reported its highest ever quarterly EBITDA of INR 252.5 crores for Q1 FY27, driven by a recovery in customer demand, higher specialty care contribution, and successful commercial execution despite feedstock volatility. Consolidated volumes grew by 5% year-on-year, with strong growth performances in India and the Americas region. Management maintained its full-year volume growth guidance at 6% to 8% while raising the EBITDA per metric ton guidance range to INR 24,000 to INR 25,000. Additionally, the company is progressing on its Mexico EPC project and anticipates commercialization over the next 12 months. Galaxy Surfactants Limited reported its Q1FY27 financial results and investor presentation for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

guidance.claim: The company maintains its full-year volume guidance at 6% to 8% for FY26-27.
guidance.quote: As regards to our guidance for the full year, we maintain our volume guidance at 6% to 8% for the full-year FY26-27, but I, however, increased the range of the EBITDA per metric ton guidance from the current INR 19,000 to INR 21,000 per metric ton to INR 24,000 to INR 25,000 per metric ton.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 volume growth and EBITDA per metric ton to reach the higher end of their respective guidance ranges, assuming current conditions persist.
guidance.quote: Q1, we are looking that you'll be able to -- we'll be delivering close to the higher end of the volume guidance range of 6% to 8%. And EBITDA as well at the higher end of the range of INR19,000 to INR21,000 metric tonne.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that full-year performance will match Q1 levels if the current scenario continues without worsening.
guidance.quote: If this is the situation what we have in Q1 continues, I think we'll also be able to deliver that for the full year.

demand_outlook.claim: Consolidated volumes grew by 5% year-on-year during the quarter with mid-single-digit growth across both segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Against this backdrop, I am pleased to report a meaningful recovery in growth momentum. Consolidated volumes grew by 5% year-on-year with both our segments growing in mid-single-digit.

demand_outlook.claim: India region volumes grew by 11% driven by double-digit growth in the performance segment and high single-digit growth in specialty products.
demand_outlook.quote: India, our primary engine grew by an impressive 11% led by double-digit growth in performance segment and high single-digit growth in specialty products.

demand_outlook.claim: Rest of the World region volume grew by 6% year-on-year, led by demand recovery in the Americas and strong performance at TRI-K.
demand_outlook.quote: Rest of the World region volume grew by 6% year-on-year. The Americas led the growth as demand recovered following greater clarity on tariff-related developments, while our premium specialty business at TRI-K continued its strong performance.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand indicators remain encouraging across key markets with expected healthy demand through coming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: As we look ahead, demand indicators remain encouraging across many of our key markets. With the upcoming festive season in India and improving momentum across several international markets, we expect demand to remain healthy through the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: Management is encouraged by the recovery in customer demand and strong momentum in Specialty Care.
demand_outlook.quote: While we remain watchful of evolving geopolitical developments and their impact on global supply chains, we are encouraged by the recovery in customer demand, the strong momentum in Specialty Care and the continued strength of our India business.

demand_outlook.claim: Consolidated volume growth was in the mid-single digits.
demand_outlook.quote: Consolidated volume growth in the mid-single digits, with a balanced contribution from both Performance Surfactants and Specialty Care

demand_outlook.claim: India returned to double-digit volume growth after nearly two years.
demand_outlook.quote: India returned to double-digit volume growth after nearly two years, significantly outpacing market growth, driven by strong demand from Tier-1 customers and the return of reformulation-related volumes that had been impacted in earlier quarters

demand_outlook.claim: AMET witnessed a low-single-digit YoY decline due to geopolitical disruptions in West Asia.
demand_outlook.quote: AMET witnessed a low-single-digit YoY decline due to geopolitical disruptions in West Asia.

demand_outlook.claim: ROW delivered mid-single-digit growth led by APAC and improving momentum in the Americas following the revision of US tariffs.
demand_outlook.quote: ROW delivered mid-single-digit growth, led by APAC and improving momentum in the Americas following the revision of US tariffs

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that India volumes grew 8% year-on-year, supported by steady demand across Tier 1 and non-Tier 1 accounts.
demand_outlook.quote: India remained relatively resilient, supported by steady demand across Tier 1 and non-Tier 1 accounts. India volumes grew 8% year-on-year, driven by a 3% growth in performance and more than 27% growth in specialty volumes.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the AMET region experienced a 15% year-on-year volume decline in Q4 due to logistics disruptions, raw material constraints, and customer repricing.
demand_outlook.quote: In contrast, the AMET region remains challenging for reasons outlined earlier with volumes declining 15% year-on-year in Q4. This weakness was concentrated in the later part of the quarter and was largely driven by logistic disruptions, raw material availability constraints, customer repricing pressures and more cautious procurement behavior amidst heightened political -- geopolitical uncertainty.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Americas region saw sequential demand recovery and reinitiated specialty pipelines following tariff reversals.
demand_outlook.quote: In contrast, the Americas emerged as a relative bright spot during the quarter, following improved clarity and partial reversals. On tariff-related developments, demand momentum strengthened sequentially with volumes improving over Q3. Importantly, our specialty pipeline in the U.S. has been reinitiated post tariff reversals, and we are seeing encouraging traction and strong growth potential in premium specialty products.

capex_expansion.claim: The Mexico EPC project continues to progress as planned and remains on track for commercialization over the next 12 months.
capex_expansion.quote: I'm also pleased with the progress being made with our EPC project in Mexico. The project continues to progress as planned, contributing EPC service income during the quarter, and we remain on track for commercialization over the next 12 months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to incur an annual capex of about INR 150 crores this year.
capex_expansion.quote: So I think this year, we will be at about an additional listing of about INR 150 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 EBITDA stood at INR 252.5 crores compared to INR 135.1 crores in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: For quarter one, I'm pleased to inform you all that the EBITDA stood at INR 252.5 crores compared to INR 135.1 crores in Q1 FY26, while EBITDA per metric ton improved to INR 35,458 per metric ton from approximately INR 20,009 per metric ton in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew 87% YoY to ₹252 Cr and EBITDA per MT improved to ₹35,458/MT.
margins_costs.quote: Strong earnings recovery, with EBITDA growing 87% YoY to ₹252 Cr and EBITDA/MT improving to ₹35,458/MT, driven by disciplined pricing, a favourable product mix within the Specialty Care segment, operational excellence, improved operating leverage and robust risk management, despite a volatile raw material environment

margins_costs.claim: Raw material markets remained volatile with elevated fatty alcohol prices and higher petrochemical feedstock costs.
margins_costs.quote: Raw material markets remained volatile, with elevated fatty alcohol prices and higher petrochemical feedstock costs following the increase in crude oil prices

margins_costs.claim: Management reported Q4 FY26 EBITDA at INR122 crores with an EBITDA per metric ton of INR20,114.
margins_costs.quote: For Q4 FY '26, EBITDA stood at INR122 crores compared to INR135 crores in the earlier year quarter 4 with EBITDA per metric ton for Q4 FY '26 at INR20,114 per metric ton versus INR21,715 per metric ton in Q4 FY '25.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that geopolitical tensions caused significant increases in feedstock and raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply chain front, due to the impact of the geopolitical situation, price of feedstocks has increased significantly. The sharp and simultaneous escalation across input raw materials created a highly challenging operating environment, exerting a need for repricing at major customer levels impacting overall Q4 volumes.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter experienced significant feedstock volatility in petrochemical and oleochemical feedstocks driven by West Asia developments.
risks_headwinds.quote: Q1 was characterized by significant volatility in feedstocks, both petrochemical and oleochemical, primarily driven by developments in West Asia.

risks_headwinds.claim: Egypt operations and regional supply chains were impacted during April and early May due to West Asia developments.
risks_headwinds.quote: The development in the West Asia created significant disruptions across the region during April and early May, impacting both inbound and outbound supply chains. Our Egypt operations were also affected during this period.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management remains watchful of evolving geopolitical developments and their impact on global supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: While we remain watchful of evolving geopolitical developments and their impact on global supply chains, we are encouraged by the recovery in customer demand, the strong momentum in Specialty Care and the continued strength of our India business.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the West Asia war introduced prolonged uncertainty and disruptions across global supply chains and trade routes.
risks_headwinds.quote: West Asia war introduced a prolonged period of uncertainty across global supply chains, trade routes and energy markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management pointed out that port congestion and vessel availability constraints led to extended transit times and hindered dispatches for the Egypt facility.
risks_headwinds.quote: Port congestion and vessel availability constraints led to extended transit times adversely impacting our dispatches.

management_commitments.claim: The Mexico EPC project remains on track for commercialization over the next 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: The project continues to progress as planned, contributing EPC service income during the quarter, and we remain on track for commercialization over the next 12 months.

management_commitments.claim: New products will contribute greater than 5% of total revenue and contribution margins by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: And we do look at all new products, -- this thing is by 2030, they should contribute to almost greater than 5% of our total revenue and our contribution margins.

management_commitments.claim: The company maintains its volume guidance at 6% to 8% for the full-year FY26-27.
management_commitments.quote: As regards to our guidance for the full year, we maintain our volume guidance at 6% to 8% for the full-year FY26-27, but I, however, increased the range of the EBITDA per metric ton guidance from the current INR 19,000 to INR 21,000 per metric ton to INR 24,000 to INR 25,000 per metric ton.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
